29
Rainforest · Fri Jan 29

El Yunque · Waterfalls & Jungle

La Mina Falls

A waterfall you can stand under

The signature hike drops down to a cold pool at the base of the falls. Bring a swimsuit and water shoes, the rocks are slick and the water is genuinely cold.

Yokahu Tower

Stone tower above the canopy

Built in 1963 as an observation lookout. Climb the spiral stairs for a view over the whole rainforest and straight out to the Atlantic.

Catamaran · Sat Jan 30

Catamaran to Culebra

The destination

The quieter coves

Turquoise water so clear you can see the reef from the deck. Anchored in a horseshoe bay with a handful of other boats.

The water

The water really is like this

Not filtered, not staged. Culebra sits in one of the most vivid stretches of the Caribbean.

Flamenco Beach

Pale sand, empty stretches

Consistently ranked one of the best beaches in the world. Even on busy days you can find open sand.

31
Free Day · Sun Jan 31

Your Day

Playa Fortuna

The beach out front

Sundays on Playa Fortuna are the quietest of the week. Locals bring horses down for the morning. Coffee from the bakery, feet in the sand.

Rio Mar at Wyndham · 5 min away

Golf with the Atlantic on your left

Two Troon managed championship courses. The Ocean Course by Tom and George Fazio runs right along the water and palms. The River Course by Greg Norman plays inland toward the rainforest. Book tee times ahead.

Horseback on the coast

Ride out at golden hour

Guided coastal trail rides run in the afternoon and finish along the water at sunset. Beginner friendly, no experience needed. Easy to book a day or two ahead.

Pool day at the villa

A day at the house

Pool floats, a drink, and a book you actually finish. The main house has a pool table, ping pong, hammocks and plenty of shade.

The oceanfront deck

Quiet end of the property

Hammocks strung along the beachfront wall. Disappear for a few hours and let the day go by.

Tap any scene to expand

A few ideas

🏌 Golf · Rio Mar at Wyndham 🐴 Horseback on the coast 🌊 Bio bay kayak · Fajardo 🛍 Old San Juan shopping 🛌 Sleep in
Golf · Rio Mar at Wyndham Country ClubFive minutes away. Two Troon managed championship courses: the Ocean Course by Tom and George Fazio, and the River Course by Greg Norman. Rainforest on one side, Atlantic on the other. Book tee times ahead, roughly $200 to $250 a round.
Horseback Riding · Coastal TrailsGuided rides along the coast, usually a couple of hours, ending at the water around sunset. Beginner friendly. Worth booking a day or two out.
Bioluminescent Bay · Laguna Grande, FajardoAbout 25 minutes east. Paddle through mangrove channels at night into a lagoon where every stroke of the paddle lights up blue. Around $50 a person for a two hour guided tour. Brightest on the darkest nights of the moon cycle.
